thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate observed for /v1/generate in us-east-1. Automatic page sent to #incidents and on-call. (rule: api-5xx-spike)

Jonah: acked. I'm on the bridge. pulling logs now.

Maria: i'll start customer impact assessment. quick question: do we know which customers saw errors or just internal rate?

Jonah: initial graph shows 5xx spike started ~14:12 UTC, peaked at ~14:16, now still elevated but trending down. likely transient but hitting a few high-traffic tenants.

Sara: i'm checking ingress metrics + recent deploys. no deploys in last 12h for api. could be upstream redis flaps.

Ops Oncall: handing off to Eli — i'm stepping out for a call. Eli, details in the bridge: traces, traces-id 0x9f3, span sampling increased.

Eli: thanks. i have the bridge. quick triage plan: 1) confirm affected model endpoints 2) check host oom/restarts 3) run traffic-cut to lower-priority pool if needed.

Jonah: confirmed affected endpoints are: /v1/generate (gpt-redwood-v2), /v1/chat. Amplified errors are 502/504 gateway and some 500s from model runtime.

Maria: customer-impact note for status page: we should post "Degraded performance & increased error rate for text-generation endpoints in US-EAST affecting a subset of requests; engineers investigating." keep short and non-technical. propose we set status to "degraded" not "major outage" for now.

Support Bot: Suggested external message template (short):
```
We’re currently investigating elevated errors affecting text-generation in US-EAST. Some requests may fail or time out. We’re working to restore normal service and will post updates here. Estimated next update: 30 minutes.
```

Maria: +1. If we need to notify only impacted customers via Zendesk/Intercom, use this template below (copyable macro).

Support Bot: Zendesk macro (copy into ticket reply):
```
Hi {{customer_name}},

Thanks for the report — we’re aware of elevated errors impacting text-generation in US-EAST which may affect your requests to the /v1/generate endpoint. Our engineers are investigating and working on mitigation.

What we’re doing: we’ve identified elevated 5xx responses from a portion of the runtime fleet and are running mitigations.

Workaround: retry after ~30s or route requests to a different region (if possible) until we follow up.

We’ll update this ticket and the status page as we have more info.

– Redwood Support
```

Jonah: also add a short internal note for SREs about rate-limited retries and clients to avoid flooding: "do not advise customers to spin up aggressive retries; recommend exponential backoff."

Eli: running quick diagnostic commands on the bridge:
```
# check pod restarts
kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep gpt-redwood
# check gateway error rates
curl -s http://metrics.internal/recent?metric=api.gateway.5xx | jq .
```

Sara: found a pattern — a small subset of inference nodes reporting higher rt and occasional 500s correlating with kernel ooms. grabbing dmesg and host metrics now.

Ops Oncall: for mitigation, propose: 1) exclude bad hosts from load balancer 2) shift high-priority traffic to reserved capacity (if redundancy ok) 3) throttle background batching jobs.

Maria: can someone draft the status page blurb and the internal comms template for Eng Managers? I'll post both once approved. Here’s a quick internal comm suggestion:
```
Short internal alert for Eng Managers:
We’re investigating elevated 5xxs in US-EAST impacting text-generation. Engineers identified a small portion of the inference fleet with instability. Mitigations in progress (host isolation + traffic redistribution). We’ll update within 30 minutes. Impact: subset of customers may see failed requests or timeouts. No confirmed data exfiltration. Postmortem ticket: PM-INC-2026-047.
```

Jonah: Maria, go ahead and post the status page message. keep the public language non-technical. I'll coordinate the LB host exclusion and coordinate with infra to ensure no cascading autoscaler actions.

Maria: posting now. status page: "Degraded performance in US-EAST for text-generation endpoints; engineers investigating. Some requests may fail or time out. Next update in 30 minutes." :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Support Bot: Patch for Support agents — troubleshooting checklist (short):
- Confirm customer region (US-EAST?)
- Ask for recent request IDs / timestamps
- Suggest retry with exponential backoff (do not instruct rapid retries)
- Offer to route to alternate region if customer can reconfigure
- Escalate to oncall if customer is on a dedicated/reserved plan and errors persist

Eli: mitigation step executed: isolated 4 hosts from LB, restarted model runtime on each, monitoring. errors dropping in 10m windows.

Sara: kernel logs show memory cgroup pressure; removing hosts reduced 5xx. opening infra ticket to investigate kernel upgrade and OOM handling.

Jonah: good mitigation. Maria — please push a second public update with: "Engineers have identified and isolated problematic hosts; error rate is decreasing. Some customers may still see intermittent errors. Investigations into root cause continue."

Maria: posted update. i'll also create a Zendesk macro with a brief follow-up for customers who already opened tickets. copy below:
```
Follow-up macro:
Hi {{customer_name}},

Update: We’ve isolated problematic hosts and error rates are decreasing. You may still see intermittent failures for a short period — we’ll confirm full restoration in our next update.

If you’re on a reserved plan and continue to face issues, please reply and we’ll escalate immediately.

– Redwood Support
```

Support Bot: For internal record, please tag the incident thread with: incident-type:infrastructure, region:us-east, severity:sev-2, owners:eng-runtime,eng-infra,customer-support.

Eli: monitoring dashboard shows 5xx back to baseline after ~22 minutes. I'm going to keep the 4 hosts isolated until we finish diagnostic (expected ~2-4 hours).

Jonah: closing the bridge in 10m if stable. please file follow-up action items: kernel upgrade plan, improved OOM instrumentation, automated host quarantine runbook.

Maria: created ticket PM-INC-2026-047 with action items and assigned owners. Drafting the postmortem skeleton now.

Eli: thanks everyone. small ask for Support leads: use the follow-up macro for customers already notified and close duplicates with the short update.

Support Bot: Example short Intercom message for impacted customers: "We’ve reduced error rates for text-generation in US-EAST. If you still experience issues, reply here and include a sample request id and timestamp."

Jonah: :thumbsup: great work. leaving logs and traces for postmortem.

Maria: marking this thread as incident-handled for now. will reopen if errors resurge. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
